title: WFC-FDM Foundry Structural & Fabrication Brief
description: Schema defining the spatial envelope, funicular form-finding mode, boundary supports, material properties, structural load cases, and acceptance criteria for any WFC-FDM Foundry design-verification run.

$schema.description: Relative or URI path to this JSON Schema.

id.description: Unique lowercase slug identifying the brief (used for run directories and logs).

name.description: Human-readable title of the structural & fabrication brief.

version.description: Semantic version of the brief specification.

description.description: Plain-English architectural, structural, and fabrication intent.

envelope.description: 3D bounding envelope and ground datum in Z-up metric coordinates.

coordinateSystem.description: Right-handed Cartesian coordinate convention (Z-up, gravity along -Z).

maxPlanX.description: Maximum allowed footprint span along X (m).

maxPlanY.description: Maximum allowed footprint span along Y (m).

targetHeightZ.description: Nominal target overall height along Z above groundZ (m).

minHeightZ.description: Minimum acceptable overall height along Z (m).

maxHeightZ.description: Maximum acceptable overall height along Z (m).

groundTolerance.description: Maximum allowed |z - groundZ| deviation for ground anchor nodes (m).

funicular.description: Force Density Method (FDM) equilibrium mode and residual requirements.

mode.description: Preferred FDM mode ('auto' lets the generator choose among allowedModes).

allowedModes.description: Permitted FDM form-finding modes for this brief.

maxEquilibriumResidualNorm.description: Maximum allowed Euclidean residual norm of the FDM equilibrium solve.

supports.description: Boundary condition and anchor count constraints.

minAnchors.description: Minimum number of structural anchor/support nodes (typically >= 3 for 3D stability).

maxAnchors.description: Maximum number of structural anchor/support nodes.

mustBeOnGround.description: If true, every anchor vertex must lie within groundTolerance of envelope.groundZ.

restraintType.description: Support DOF restraint model: 'pinned' (ux=uy=uz=0, free rotations) or 'fixed' (all 6 DOFs restrained).

material.description: Isotropic linear-elastic & strength parameters for the structural fabrication material.

name.description: Material name (e.g., Cast Gypsum Plaster, Timber, Steel, Glass-Fiber Reinforced Gypsum).

youngsModulusPa.description: Elastic Young's modulus E in Pascals (N/m^2).

poissonsRatio.description: Poisson's ratio nu (used to derive shear modulus G = E / (2*(1+nu))).

compressiveStrengthPa.description: Characteristic compressive strength f_c in Pascals.

tensileStrengthPa.description: Characteristic tensile / flexural strength f_t in Pascals (governing limit for brittle plaster).

shearStrengthPa.description: Characteristic shear strength f_v in Pascals.

loadCases.description: Ordered list of structural load cases evaluated by the independent FEA verifier.

name.description: Human-readable description of the load case.

required.description: If true, failing this load case fails the overall candidate verdict.

idealTarget.description: Marks a stretch or primary performance load case.

gravityMS2.description: Downward gravitational acceleration g in m/s^2 (typically 9.81).

distributedVerticalMassKg.description: Total imposed downward vertical mass in kg (converted to force Fz = -mass * gravityMS2).

distribution.description: Spatial distribution rule for applying the imposed vertical load across free nodes.

topZoneFractionZ.description: When distribution is 'top_zone_nodes', nodes with z >= groundZ + topZoneFractionZ * H receive equal shares of the imposed vertical load.

note.description: Additional physical interpretation of the load case.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Quantitative pass/fail thresholds for structural serviceability, strength, stability, and fabrication geometry.

characteristicLengthDef.description: Formula or description for characteristic span L used with maxDeflectionRatio.

maxDeflectionMeters.description: Hard absolute deflection ceiling in meters (e.g., L/300 on governing span).

maxDeflectionHeightRatioMeters.description: Optional secondary deflection reference based on overall height (e.g., H/300 in meters).

minTensileSafetyFactor.description: Minimum required tensile safety factor SF_t = f_t / max(sigma_t).

minCompressiveSafetyFactor.description: Minimum required compressive safety factor SF_c = f_c / max(|sigma_c|).

minBucklingSafetyFactor.description: Minimum required Euler buckling safety factor SF_b = min(P_cr / |N|) across compressed members.

requireSingleConnectedComponent.description: If true, the centerline graph must be a single connected component.

requireWatertightManifoldMesh.description: If true, the exported tubular .obj mesh must have 0 boundary edges, 0 non-manifold edges, and positive signed volume.

minMemberLengthM.description: Minimum allowed centerline edge length (m) to prevent degenerate cast joints.

maxSlendernessRatio.description: Maximum allowed member slenderness L / r_g (where r_g = sqrt(I / A)).

minTubeOuterRadiusM.description: Minimum allowed cast tube outer radius (m) for moldability and handling.

maxTubeOuterRadiusM.description: Maximum allowed cast tube outer radius (m) to prevent excessive mass or joint clashing.

minWallThicknessM.description: Minimum wall thickness (outerRadiusM - innerRadiusM) when hollow sections are used (m).

topology.description: WFC voxel grid resolution and graph topology constraints.

minGridResolution.description: Minimum allowed [nx, ny, nz] WFC voxel grid resolution (e.g. [2, 2, 2]).

geometry.description: Tubular mesh topology, longitudinal subdivision, and Planar Quad (PQ) constraints.

requireTubeTopology.description: Every bar must be solidified with watertight quad-dominant tube topology.

minLongitudinalSubdivLevels.description: Minimum number of {longitudinal subdivision + PQ} passes per bar.

requirePQOptimization.description: If true, Planar Quad (PQ) planarization must be applied.

fabrication.description: Unrolled 2D strip fabrication pattern and castability requirements.

requireUnrolledPatternsPerBar.description: Every bar must produce a valid 2D unrolled fabrication pattern.

objectives.description: Ordered multi-objective Pareto optimization goals (e.g., minimize totalUnrolledSurfaceAreaM2, minimize elementCount, minimize centerlineMassKg).

deliverables.description: Mandatory Foundry communication artifacts (Goldilocks 3D HTML explainer + 60s showcase video).
